title: 부탁하고 시키기: 늦지 않도록, 일찍 오게 했어요
objective: By the end, you can use V-도록 to give the purpose of an action and V-게 하다 (V-도록 하다) to say that someone made or let another person do something. You can also avoid the common tense and -(으)려고 mistakes.
summary: This worksheet compares -도록 (do something so that a result happens) with -게 하다 / -도록 하다 (make or let someone do something).

task.title: Use -도록 and -게 하다
task.line: Do each item the way its instruction says: choose, fill in, fix, combine, put in order, or answer.

forms.when: Add -도록 to any verb stem, with or without a final consonant (가도록, 먹도록).
forms.means: 'so that ~ (can) happen'. It gives the goal of the action that comes next.
forms.example: 뒤에 앉은 사람도 잘 들리도록 크게 말해 주세요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Please speak loudly so that people sitting in the back can hear, too.

forms.when: Use this to say what you want to prevent. It works well with advice and requests.
forms.exampleMeaning: Dress warmly so that you don't catch a cold.

forms.when: Add -게 하다 to a verb stem. The person who does the action takes 에게 (or 을/를 with verbs like 웃다, 울다).
forms.means: 'make / let someone do ~'. The subject does not do the action. Another person does it.
forms.example: 엄마가 동생에게 매일 우유를 마시게 해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Mom makes my little brother drink milk every day.

forms.when: This means the same as -게 하다 but sounds a little more formal. -도록 하세요 is also used for polite, firm instructions.
forms.means: 'make someone do ~' / 'please make sure you do ~'
forms.exampleMeaning: Please make sure you send the meeting materials by Friday.

watchOut: 늦지 않으려고 일찍 오세요 (X) → 늦지 않도록 일찍 오세요 (O): Before a command or request (-세요, -아/어 주세요), use -도록, not -(으)려고.
늦지 않았도록 (X) → 늦지 않도록 (O): Never add a past tense marker before -도록. Tense goes at the end of the sentence.
먹었게 했어요 (X) → 먹게 했어요 (O): With -게 하다, put the past tense on 하다 (했어요), not on the verb before -게.
exercises: Write 도록 or 게 했어요 in the blank: ① 아기가 깨지 않____ 조용히 들어오세요. ② 선생님이 학생들에게 새 단어를 다섯 번씩 쓰____.
Fill in the blank with 끊다 + -게 하다 in the past tense: 의사가 할아버지에게 담배를 ____.
Find the mistake and rewrite the sentence: 우산을 잃어버리지 않으려고 여기에 두세요.
Combine the two sentences into one with -도록: 아이들이 쉽게 이해해요. / 그림을 넣어서 설명했어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 쓰게 / 저에게 / 하셨어요 / 팀장님이 / 다시 / 보고서를
Answer in Korean: who did the action? ① 사장님이 아르바이트생에게 창문을 닦게 했어요. 누가 창문을 닦았어요? ② 저는 룸메이트가 푹 자도록 불을 껐어요. 누가 불을 껐어요?
answers: ① 도록 ② 게 했어요 (도록 했어요)
않으려고 → 않도록: 우산을 잃어버리지 않도록 여기에 두세요.
아이들이 쉽게 이해하도록 그림을 넣어서 설명했어요.
팀장님이 저에게 보고서를 다시 쓰게 하셨어요. (팀장님이 저에게 다시 보고서를 쓰게 하셨어요. / 팀장님이 보고서를 저에게 다시 쓰게 하셨어요.)
